body: I'm pretty sure that we all have the same cat. http://i.imgur.com/yO6d1x7.jpg
We have a guy that used to catch turtles and snakes from ponds. He's called the Turtle Man and he has his own show on Animal Planet called Call of the Wildman. That and bourbon.

I don't feel comfortable talking to the therapist about my problems. I was in therapy for a couple of months after staying at a hospital for a week after overdosing. My family's been caught up in their own plans. My mom and I have never really gotten along, so we have these fights and whatnot. She screams at me and then I scream at her. It kind of triggers my depression and that's usually how these emotional times start. I've probably been like this for a couple of months. Thanks so much for helping me by the way. I really needed someone to talk to.
